findings.title: Federated rule group check dropped for legacy CombinedRule abilities
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` used to mark rules as immutable when `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` was true. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false`. In the legacy list and detail views, Mimir federated rule groups will now show Update/Delete/Pause actions as supported, letting users try to edit or delete rules that should be read-only.

findings.title: Delete and Pause are never shown in the new list view
findings.body: The new list view no longer passes `rulerRule`. `canDelete` and `canPause` can be true from the prom-rule abilities, but the menu items are still gated on `rulerRule` existing (`canDelete && rulerRule`, and `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` for pause). Users with delete or edit permission therefore lose the Delete and Pause actions in the list view. The new GrafanaGroupLoader test asserts exactly 4 menu items while delete permissions are granted, which hides this regression.

findings.title: Silence menu item does nothing when only promRule is available
findings.body: In the list view `canSilence` is computed from the prom rule, so the 'Silence notifications' item is shown. Clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer`, but the drawer only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. `rule` is now undefined in the list view, so clicking the item silently does nothing.

findings.title: Missing React key on GrafanaRuleListItem in rules.map
findings.body: The previous `GrafanaRuleLoader` was rendered with `key={key}`, but the replacement `GrafanaRuleListItem` has no key. This causes React key warnings. It can also make React reconcile list items incorrectly as results are appended, for example reusing the wrong component state such as an open menu, drawer or modal for a different rule.

findings.title: Export and Pause disabled for Grafana recording rules in prom-based abilities
findings.body: The ruler-based abilities use `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule`, which is true for any Grafana rule including recording rules. The new prom-based abilities use `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` for ModifyExport, Pause, Restore and DeletePermanently. As a result, Grafana-managed recording rules in the new list view can no longer be exported or paused, which is a behavioural regression.

findings.title: Rule view link no longer includes returnTo
findings.body: The old item built the href with `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`, { returnTo })`. The new one omits `returnTo`. After opening a rule from a filtered or searched list, the back navigation in the rule viewer no longer returns the user to their filtered list.
